verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents custom AI filters, written as plain-English scripts, that automatically label, star and archive mail, which covers both auto-labeling and steering. It also documents Splits by importance and one-click identification of important emails and todos, which covers categorizing and surfacing what needs attention. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to audit or review what the AI did or why, and community feedback mostly concerns manual Bundles rather than AI triage. missing for 10: an audit trail or explanation of AI triage actions, independent hands-on corroboration of AI filter accuracy, documentation that importance classification is AI-driven rather than rule-based.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.
You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries
Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos
